objective: Do learners feel prepared for the subject?

preparednessInterpretation.afterOneRecommendedSet: No persona should feel whole-subject ready; the product now reports that honestly.
preparednessInterpretation.afterCompleteLearnAndMocks: The diligent and average personas have a credible paper-shaped route; the lazy persona does not.
preparednessInterpretation.limit: This is verified product coverage, not a longitudinal learner-outcome claim.

learnPaperShape.IBM: 4 short-answer per module run; written-first recommendation
learnPaperShape.SCLM: up to 2 numeric items where authored

freshMocks.selection: Each later fixed set prioritises paper-relevant concepts earlier sets did not reach; the subject cycle stops at complete coverage after a minimum of three sets.
freshMocks.weakestLinks: A separate dynamic paper fills the real section shape weakest-first from the learner's Learn evidence and is excluded from the common coverage cycle.

objectiveCraft.strategy: choose one of the longest options
